captures.caption: First 12 s after launch: desktop window, XR off, no input

Scripted flight on desktop, XR off, from a fresh first launch: Play from the main menu with ENTER, take off from the perch with SPACE flaps, then W for speed, A and D rolls, a SHIFT dive and more flaps; the game's first-flight lessons at the top advance as the input does what they ask
Taking off from the spawn perch with SPACE, while the game's lesson asks for exactly that (6.5 s into the recording)
Gliding past the village church; the tutorial counts the glide (14 s into the recording)
Over the lake and fields after A and D rolls (25 s into the recording)
